params.body:
Cloning a project with its evaluations lost part of each evaluation. The subgoals and the maxima stayed behind, and every copied evaluation got the day of cloning as its date. The clone also carried the team, the class groups and the loose pupils along without asking, last year's class groups included. Separately, saving an evaluation's form wiped its subgoals.

## What a cloned evaluation takes along

- **Attainment levels, maxima and subgoals:** the evaluation copies its `att_level_evaluation` rows as they are. Until now `cloneWithProject` loaded `attainmentLevels` (level 1 only) and synced it by id, so the pivot `max` stayed behind and the level-2 rows of the same table were never read.
- **Tests by question:** they copy their questions and lines as before, and rebuild their maxima from the lines (S3-9).
- **Company evaluations:** the pupils a company evaluation names come along when they are in the new project.
- **Never:** scores, absences and feedback.

The form says this in one sentence above the evaluations. There is no checkbox for it.

## Dates

- **Adjusted to the new start date (default):** a copied evaluation lies as many days after the new start as it did after the old one. The date decides in which term an evaluation counts and on which school year's reports it shows, so the day of cloning put every copied evaluation in the running term.
- **Kept:** the teacher can choose "Dezelfde datum houden". For a project of another school year the form warns that those evaluations then do not count on this year's reports.
- **On the form:** each evaluation shows the date it will get, with the old date after "was". The dates follow the start date and the choice as the teacher changes them (Alpine, already on the page through Livewire).
- **Another school year:** the form proposes the start and end date moved by whole school years, so an untouched form lands in the current year.

## Who comes along

- **Team:** ticked.
- **Class groups and loose pupils:** offered, not ticked, so a copy gets no pupils nobody chose.
- **Class groups of another school year:** never come along, because a class group belongs to its year (`CurrentSchoolyearScope`). The form says so instead of offering them.

Until now the team, the class groups and the loose pupils always came along.

## Other fixes

- **The evaluation form wiped subgoals:** `syncAttainmentLevels` called `sync()` on `attainmentLevels()`. Its `level = 1` filter does not reach the pivot query, so every save detached every subgoal, even when only the title changed. It now attaches and detaches attainment levels only, and a level that leaves takes its subgoals with it. Subgoals already lost this way cannot be restored, because nothing records what was there.
- **Copies inherited loaded relations:** `replicate()` handed the original's loaded relations to the copy, and the policy loads the team on the original. Copies now start without relations.
- **Unvalidated input:** the clone now goes through `CloneProjectRequest`. An empty name gave a server error and is now a validation error, as is an end date before the start date. Any evaluation id was accepted, also one from another school; now only evaluations of the original are cloned.

## Existing copies

These are not repaired, and no reliable repair exists:

- A copy is not linked to its original, so pairing them is a guess.
- A copy that has been used already had its maxima entered again, since no score can be entered without one.
- A missing subgoal cannot be told apart from one left out on purpose.

## Rules

- New: R S1-4.1 to R S1-4.5, and a new chapter S2 with R S2-1.1.
- Updated: the S1 intro.

## Deploy

No migration and no new assets.

## Tests

- **ProjectServiceTest:** subgoals, maxima, date adjusted and kept, the people choices, a class group of another year, company pupils, and only evaluations of the original.
- **CloningAProjectTest (new, over HTTP):** the defaults for a project of this year and of last year, the choices applied, the refusals, and a 403 for a stranger.
- **EvaluationControllerTest:** saving the form keeps the subgoals of the levels that stay.
- **Mutation check:** 19 hand-made mutants are all killed: subgoals and maxima dropped, the date set to today, not adjusted or not kept, each people choice and default, a class group of another year, loaded relations replicated, the server refusals, and both ways the form save lost subgoals.
- **In a browser:** checked in Chromium. Moving the start a week moves every shown date a week, "Dezelfde datum houden" shows the old dates, and switching back shows the new ones again.
- **Full suite:** 1415 passed, 20 failed, 6 skipped. The 20 are the workbench baseline (Chrome/PDF, archiving, build stamp), the same list as on main. Pint and PHPStan are clean.
params.title: Cloning keeps an evaluation whole and asks who comes along
